title: 🐛 Fix regression when using `str` with `Form()`
body:
## Pull Request

Discussion: Closes https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/discussions/14471

## Description

Closes https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/discussions/14471

This fixes a regression introduced in version 0.123.2. After upgrading one of my projects, endpoints suddenly started throwing `HTTP 422` responses due to empty string form values being passed. The key was definitely being passed, but because it was empty, it was being treated as if it wasn't passed at all. Fixing this would require adding `= ""` to all my string based form endpoints, which is a lot.

The long term solution is to fix the regression itself. This commit adds an explicit check for empty string values on fields which have an explicit string type. If both conditions are met, an empty string is used instead of `None`, as it was pre-regression.
